_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 58: 2 March 2026. Completes March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions Africa and says the Lord said there would be many, many small 9/11s throughout the nation, repeated, and that this is what they have been praying over for more than a year.
mentions.quote: Many many small 9/11s throughout the nation
mentions.time_phrase: praying over it for a year
mentions.falsify_match: Multiple smaller mass-casualty attacks across the country.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Small 9/11s has no threshold, so ordinary incidents can be read into it, and a year of prayer is offered as why they have not happened.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told to tell them he is bringing down the walls because he wants a revival and a harvest of souls, that it cannot be done with everybody pinned against everybody, and that he wants to deal with racial hurts and offence.
mentions.quote: TELL THEM I'M BRINGING DOWN THE WALLS. I WANT A REVIVAL
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable racial reconciliation within the churches.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Worth recording as one of the few places the material asks something of his own audience rather than of their opponents.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has redeemed them from it, cites Galatians 3:13, says they can latch onto it if they like it as something else to stand on, that he believes it, and thanks God for creative ideas to get wealth.
mentions.quote: It's something else for you to stand on

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told to believe him for the first quarter for the whole year's budget, for everything they are believing for to come in the first quarter of the year, and refers to the third.
mentions.quote: believe me for the first quarter for the whole year's budget
mentions.falsify_match: A full year's income arriving in the first quarter.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Said on 2 March with the quarter almost over, which leaves four weeks for a year's provision.

mentions.claim_text: He says something is coming and he is believing for good, cites that whatever things you desire when you pray you should believe you receive them and you shall have them, asks what they are saying out of their mouth, and models it with being debt free and having more than enough.
mentions.quote: What are you saying out of your mouth? I'm debt-free
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on speaking and believing it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and the condition places any shortfall on what the listener said and believed.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why and suggests she got hold of Deuteronomy 28, paraphrasing that the people of the earth will see they are called by the name of the Lord and be afraid of them, and that the Lord will give them a surplus of prosperity.
mentions.quote: Maybe she got a hold of Deuteronomy 28:10
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scriptural warrant for the surplus claims.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will show up and show off in their life, tells those believing for a baby that this is their month to conceive, and those believing for a spouse that this is their month to find them, and imagines someone saying they will find the man of their dreams this month.
mentions.quote: This is your month to conceive a baby
mentions.falsify_match: Conceptions and engagements reported among listeners in March.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable in practice: any large audience supplies both, and only the successes come back as testimony. Note the tightening from 2026 to this month.
